Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the publisher (Square Enix) with the developer, despite prior sources clearly stating Crystal Dynamics developed Tomb Raider (2013). This misinterpretation of roles (developer vs. publisher) led the Planner to propose verifying Square Enix as the developer, introducing an incorrect trajectory and unnecessary re-verification.
